author: blu
body: The map, fold, and filter family is effect-polymorphic: the row variable e names exactly the effects of the function argument, so a pure caller instantiates e to the empty row and an effectful one surfaces its effects in the result arrow.

author: blu
body: Every for expression desugars to map-list, so these rows are exercised at every for loop in every program -- including the compiler's own, which cites this chapter from Codex chapter Collections rather than keeping a second copy.
